panels.name: Added or Removed Members from Group
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Office365 "\"Workload\":\"AzureActiveDirectory\"" ("Add member to group." or "Remove member from group.") 
| json "ObjectId", "UserId", "Workload", "Operation", "ResultStatus"
| json "ExtendedProperties[0].Name", "ExtendedProperties[1].Name", "ExtendedProperties[0].Value", "ExtendedProperties[1].Value" as InputField0, InputField1, InputFieldValue0, InputFieldValue1
| where workLoad = "AzureActiveDirectory" and Operation in ("Add member to group.", "Remove member from group.")
| "" as groupName
| if (InputField0 = "Group.DisplayName", InputFieldValue0, if (InputField1 = "Group.DisplayName", InputFieldValue1, groupName ) ) as groupName
| ResultStatus as status
